entities.summary: Dolly Rebecca Parton is an American singer, songwriter, actress, philanthropist, and businesswoman. After achieving success as a songwriter for other artists, Parton's debut album, Hello, I'm Dolly, was released in 1967, commencing a career spanning 60 years and 50 studio albums. Referred to as the "Queen of Country", Parton is one of the most-honored female country performers in history and has received various accolades, including eleven Grammy Awards and three Emmy Awards, as well as nominations for two Academy Awards including an humanitarian honorary Oscar win in 2025, six Golden Globe Awards, and a Tony Award.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a renowned singer-songwriter and philanthropist, Dolly Parton has had a significant impact on country music and beyond. Her 2025 humanitarian honorary Oscar win and numerous Grammy Awards have raised awareness for literacy programs and COVID-19 vaccine research.
